title: drupilot port summary (schema_version 1)
description: The machine summary of a port printed on STDOUT by scripts/analysis/port-summary.sh (with or without --json), and saved as port-summary.json in the visible, gitignored <Drupal root>/.drupilot/ artifacts dir with --write (or into --output DIR; port-report.sh refreshes it after every report). It composes state.json plus a fresh snapshot (common.sh state_view_json), the port record (common.sh port_record_json: the port manifest merged with the decision log) and the subject's info.yml / composer.json; it computes nothing new. The whole object is one jq literal: every key below is always present, and an unknown value is null, never invented.

record_source.description: Where a port-record item comes from: the port manifest, or a log-decision.sh entry (decisions.jsonl).

schema_version.description: 1 for this shape; an additive change keeps it, a renamed or removed key bumps it.

drupilot_version.description: plugin.json's version (plugin_version); null when it cannot be read.

subject.description: Absolute path of the module/theme directory.

type.description: The info.yml type (module, theme, profile, ...), else the manifest's.

origin.description: The subject's origin checkout (origin baseline, else the test-bed marker); null when it was ported in place.

status.description: The stage, "not-started" before any, or "blocked" once ported with a blocker.

stage.description: The highest stage recorded in state.json (or the legacy phase marker).

blockers.description: Why status is "blocked"; always empty before the ported stage.

effort.description: The viability verdict (S/M/L/XL) recorded in state.json or read from assess.json (.verdict, else .effort).

core_version_requirement.description: The info.yml core_version_requirement as declared now (quotes stripped).

d10_support.description: From a core matrix computed on the current sources, else the manifest's value as recorded: declared-not-verified, verified-static, verified-static-above-floor, failed or n/a (a manifest value is passed through unchecked).

files_changed.description: manifest.files_changed (a count, or the length of a list), else the number of files in the patch.

rector_rules.description: Rector rule hits, merged by short rule name: from the manifest's rector_rules, else run-rector.sh's rector-rules.json.

rule.description: The rule's short class name (namespace dropped).

hits.description: Files changed by the rule, summed over passes; null when no source counted them.

passes.description: The passes that applied it (official, digests, ...), deduplicated.

digests.description: The manifest's digests object reduced to three keys (each value exactly as recorded, null when absent); null when the manifest has no digests object.

applied.description: As recorded: a list of rules, or a boolean in some manifests.

reverted_rules.description: Rector changes undone by hand: manifest rector_reversions items (any extra keys kept, strings normalized, "" to null) and rector-revert decision-log entries {rule, file, why, what, source, ts}; deduplicated by rule + file.

rule.description: Never null or empty (items without one are dropped).

manual_fixes.description: The manifest's manual_edits, each normalized to {edit, why, change_record} (a plain string becomes {edit: string, why: null, change_record: null}).

post_port_fixes.description: Fixes made after the validate loop / tests / core matrix found a problem: manifest items and post-port-fix decision-log entries {fix, file, why, detected_by, source, ts}.

behavior_changes.description: Changes a reviewer must check: manifest items and behavior-change decision-log entries {change, why, review_hint, file, source, ts}.

preexisting_bugs.description: Bugs found but not fixed by the port: manifest items and preexisting-bug decision-log entries {issue, file, note, source, ts}.

tooling_deviations.description: Where the flow or a tool's output was not followed: manifest items and script-divergence / skip / manual-override / tooling-deviation decision-log entries {what, why, kind, script, file, source, ts}.

test_adaptations.description: test-adaptation decision-log entries only (the manifest has no such field).

deferred.description: The manifest's deferred_to_phase2 items (non-string items serialized as JSON text).

deprecations_remaining.description: manifest.deprecations_remaining as a number (a list counts its items, a numeric string is converted).

preservation.description: The last recorded test run (last-test.json through state.json); null when none.

status.description: last-test.json's run status (passed, failed, none-run), as recorded.

tests_failed.description: Tests with status fail or error.

fresh.description: True when the run is on the current sources (same subject digest); null when unknown.

matrix.description: The last core matrix (verify-core-matrix.sh's core-matrix.json through state.json); null when none.

safety.description: Error counts the manifest recorded from check-port-safety.sh and scan-signature-changes.sh; null when it recorded neither.

patch.description: The last patch: recorded by make-patch.sh (state_patch_record), else the manifest's patch or the newest local *.patch next to the subject (kind local, at null); exists is added when the path is known. Null when there is none.

path.description: Absolute path of the patch file.

reports.description: Paths of the human reports that exist (null otherwise); summary is this file's path when --write saved it.

decisions.description: Number of decision-log entries for the subject.
